GoldenrodBikeShopClerkIntroText:
…sigh… I moved
here, but I can't

sell my BICYCLES.
Why is that?

Could you ride a
BICYCLE and adver- tise for me?
GoldenrodBikeShopClerkAgreedText:
Really? Great!

Give me your name
and phone number,

and I'll loan you
a BICYCLE.
GoldenrodBikeShopClerkFirstRateBikesText:
My BICYCLES are
first-rate! You

can ride them
anywhere.
GoldenrodBikeShopClerkRefusedText:
…sigh… Oh, for
the kindness of people…
